scientific_integrity: Complete symbolic proof with exact Pell descent and asymptotic counting; direct independent finite check 2<=b<=1000 does not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed points with identical nonzero digits are classified; arbitrary fixed points/cycles are not. An unindexed elementary argument may overlap. The three Pell parametrizations are classical inputs.
title: A five-family classification of uniform-digit fixed points of elated maps
